purpose: live attempt from unfunded testnet wallet

params.target: Own demo Solidity 0.8.28 VulnerableVault.withdrawAll(): amount=balances[msg.sender]; msg.sender.call{value:amount}(""); then totalDeposits-=balances[msg.sender]; balances[msg.sender]=0. Invariant: balance==totalDeposits

extra.description: Deduct from the caller's Telegraph escrow balance at the next epoch close. Fund it once with EscrowFacet.depositUSDC(amount); no per-request settlement.

issues: CWE-841 reentrancy: external call before state update in withdrawAll()
result.summary: MOCK ANSWER. withdrawAll() sends ether before zeroing the caller's balance, so a re-entrant caller is paid repeatedly.

params.target: Own demo code, Solidity 0.8.28, VulnerableVault: function withdrawAll()external{uint256 amount=balances[msg.sender];require(amount > 0);(bool ok,)=msg.sender.call{value: amount}("");require(ok);totalDeposits -=balances[msg.sender];balances[msg.sender]=0;}
